provider: Cloudflare for Startups — nonprofit / civil-society track

free_tier.stated: Up to $350,000 in credits for a year on the current program page (tiered: Tier 3 $10k upward). The nonprofit track announced 2025-09-22 offers 'up to $250,000 in Cloudflare credits ... which can be used for a variety of our developer and core products, including databases & storage, compute services, AI, media, and performance and security'.

retention.stated: Award is discretionary and cohort-based (501(c)(3) or equivalent required); the announcement's application window has closed, so treat as 'reapply at next intake'. Nothing about the credits is permanent — after year one the workload reverts to paid or to the small free tier.

egress.terms: N/A by construction — everything served through Cloudflare's edge, which is the egress-free property the client wants.

tooling: Cloudflare API + Wrangler; Workers bindings; rclone backend 's3' works against Cloudflare's S3-compatible object storage endpoints, and the S3 API is the documented path for the storage product.
chaining: Credit grant per organisation, applied for in cohorts ('The application period ... runs until December 1', then Cloudflare selects a cohort) — so it is a gated annual intake, not an open self-serve tier. $250k of usage-based credit at storage-class rates is a very large number of GB-months; the constraint is the one-year credit window and the cohort gate.
